channel.title: A House-Shaped House
channel.description: A House-Shaped House is my account of building Echo Pond. It stays with one house and looks beneath the finished image like a kid kicking over a rock. We thought we understood what we were taking on. Over nearly five years, the soil, the budget, the bank, the ledge, and the work itself kept showing us otherwise. Life became white-knuckle exciting. The test was not just whether we could build a house, but whether the relationships carrying it could survive what building would ask of them. I kept messages, drawings, and notes because I was often confused and trying to make sense of the build from inside it. This is neither an exemplar nor a warning. It is one story of one attempt to build a house-shaped house, told from the moments when everyone was still trying to figure out what to do next.

item.title: Interlude: What the Echo Returns
item.itunes:title: Interlude: What the Echo Returns
item.description: The pond had been named, renamed, and imagined by others long before we arrived. Old maps, a lakeside resort, two versions of the Echo myth, and Thoreau’s woods.

item.title: Part II: Choosing the House-Shaped House
item.itunes:title: Part II: Choosing the House-Shaped House
item.description: Alison had described warm rooms, a long cutting table, and places to be together or alone. The budget asked what could change, what mattered enough to keep, and whether we could continue.

item.title: Part III: Paying for the Line on the Drawing
item.itunes:title: Part III: Paying for the Line on the Drawing
item.description: We had a design we wanted, a bank that would not pay for dirt, and no way to know exactly how the rock beneath us would break.

item.itunes:title: Part IV: The Difficult Work of a Simple Form

item.title: Part V: After Completion Changes Tense
item.itunes:title: Part V: After Completion Changes Tense
item.description: We had the keys, a punch list, and a meadow that had barely begun. Living here would tell us things the drawings could not.

item.title: Coda: What Returned Changed
item.itunes:title: Coda: What Returned Changed
item.description: We knew things would go wrong and who we had thrown our fate in with. The house we had imagined gave way to the house we had always wanted without knowing how to imagine it.
